baseline_source: Prusa profile from the selected Tensile Type V G-code inspected 2026-10-15

speed60.level: 60 percent of baseline non-first-layer extrusion speed profile

speed80.level: 80 percent of baseline non-first-layer extrusion speed profile

flow095.level: 0.95 slicer extrusion multiplier; M221 stays 100 percent

flow105.level: 1.05 slicer extrusion multiplier; M221 stays 100 percent

interpretation: For three specimens per condition: one two-specimen plate plus one one-specimen plate. Nine conditions require 18 jobs / 27 specimens.
Optional final baseline check: one additional specimen makes 19 jobs / 28 specimens, or repeat the full 2+1 baseline group for 20 jobs / 30 specimens.
Numerical levels are a proposed screening design, not a validated optimum or a guaranteed printability range.
Only use nozzle levels inside the actual filament manufacturer's stated range.
Preserve first-layer conditions. In the fan sweep change normal fan min/max only; keep bridge fan, disabled initial layers, and cooling slowdown rules unchanged.

For speed scale non-first-layer extrusion feature speed settings together; leave travel, first-layer speed, acceleration and volumetric limits unchanged. Verify sliced speeds differ in the actual specimen paths; cooling and volumetric limits may dominate.
For flow vary the slicer extrusion multiplier, not both multiplier and M221.
The collector records declared conditions and actual G-code; it does not apply or certify them.
Specimens from one plate share print history. Record sequential print order and plate position; the second object begins on a bed already heated by the first print.

fan0.reason: Print failed; replaced with 5 percent fan at user request
